task.title: Build 48 photo expansion and API upload (archived; API-key upload blocked by cloud-signing permission)

result.summary: Build 48 (1.0 (48)) is built, reviewed and archived from clean final SHA bbb46e19 (local unpushed commits: 5dcb52d8 = recovered photo tap-to-expand fix via clean cherry-pick of 8256db4b, bbb46e19 = metadata-only bump). All gates passed and an independent review approved. The Founder-authorized guarded API-key upload (dry run passed every guard; execute run) FAILED at Apple signing: xcodebuild -exportArchive returned 'Cloud signing permission error: You have not been given access to cloud-managed distribution certificates' and 'No iOS Distribution signing certificate for team 33GMTRM6G9 with a private key was found'. No delivery was created; nothing reached App Store Connect; last-uploaded-build stays 47. No fallback to interactive Xcode authentication was attempted. The archive is retained unchanged. Founder Apple-side action is required.

tests.summary: PhotoBriefingTests 29/29 (incl. 2 new regression tests); full Native unit target 1225/1225 (rerun on final SHA bbb46e19, includes HealthKit suites and the renamed build-48 regression); Debug simulator build and unsigned generic Release build succeeded; project regeneration deterministic (identical hash twice) before and after the bump; git diff --check clean; release configuration verified 1.0 (48); launch smoke ok; one temporary simulator UI test (reverted, not committed) showed the hint and tile tap opening Progress Photo detail.

review.summary: Independent fresh-context review of the exact candidate 5dcb52d8 (diff scope two files; metadata commit then only touches build number): APPROVED, no blockers, covering tap-to-expand correctness, no layout or text change, no V3/Training/DEXA/HealthKit/Server/Progress-Photos-upload change, historical V2 compatibility, and upload-helper security. Non-blockers deferred to backlog.

decisions_required: Founder Apple-side action: give the upload path access to cloud-managed distribution certificates. Either (a) create a new App Store Connect team API key (Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API) whose role includes cloud-managed distribution certificate access (the Admin role is the known-sufficient choice), save its private key file under the owner-only ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys and update ASC_KEY_ID in ~/.physiqueos-release/config/release.conf, or (b) install an iOS Distribution certificate with its private key in the Mac login keychain (for example from Xcode account certificate management by the Account Holder or an Admin) so export can sign locally. Never paste key contents into chat or GitHub. Then publish a NEW task id to retry the upload of the existing archive.
blockers: API-key upload failed: the installed Developer-role key cannot use cloud-managed distribution signing and no local iOS Distribution certificate with a private key exists for team 33GMTRM6G9. Archive preserved; no interactive fallback used.
unexpected_findings: The auto-mode classifier denied even the default dry-run of physiqueos-asc-upload until the Founder authorized it in chat, despite the configured narrative allow rule. After chat authorization the dry run passed all 24 guards. A permissions.allow rule for the whole helper (python3 ~/.physiqueos-release/bin/physiqueos-asc-upload *) was then added to the Claude user settings at the Founder's explicit request; no other setting changed.
The upload failure is at signing, not authentication: the API key authenticates read-only (list-apps) but the Developer role lacks cloud distribution certificate access.
Because this blocked completion is published with the inbox task id, the inbox task becomes completed; the retry needs a new task id.
backlog: Retry TestFlight upload of the existing Build 48 archive (do not rebuild, rebump or rearchive) after the Founder Apple-side change; prove the API-key path end to end.

Next Server task (do not implement now): move ALL scheduled briefing generation to 3:00 AM local time, preserving cadence dates, with evidence cutoff semantics that deliberately include the completed prior day plus an ingestion/reconciliation buffer that covers HealthKit sync latency; audit Midweek, Weekly, Monthly and scheduled DEXA/event briefing paths; test timezone/DST and post-midnight/pre-3AM evidence; do not regenerate historical briefings.
Optional Native polish: the new Photo Briefing tile accessibility label drops the capture date (same trait as the snapshot grid); add a view-level test for the tap wiring.

Helper hardening (non-blocking, reviewer suggestions): hard-code the team id beside the bundle id; document that -allowProvisioningUpdates can create or modify certificates and profiles via the key; a killed upload leaves a stale state lock that must be removed by hand.
recommended_next_step: Founder: fix Apple-side signing access as described in decisions_required (Admin-role API key with cloud-managed distribution certificate access, or a local iOS Distribution certificate with private key), then publish a new task id to upload the retained Build 48 archive via the guarded helper. Do not start HealthKit until Build 48 is accepted.
